description: Schema for gridded analysis datasets (e.g., MRMS QPE). Represents an xarray Dataset serialized to a dict, with dimensions, coordinates, data variables, and optional metadata attributes.

dims.description: Sizes of each dimension in the dataset.

valid_time.description: Number of time steps in the dataset.

latitude.description: Number of grid points along the latitude axis.

longitude.description: Number of grid points along the longitude axis.

coords.description: Coordinate arrays associated with the dataset dimensions.

valid_time.description: UTC timestamps for each time step, encoded as an xarray coordinate object.

latitude.description: Latitude values in decimal degrees (WGS84), ranging roughly from 20° N to 55° N for CONUS.

longitude.description: Longitude values in decimal degrees (WGS84), ranging roughly from -130° to -60° for CONUS.

data_vars.description: Gridded analysis data variables. At least one variable must be present.

qpe_1hr.description: Multi-sensor quantitative precipitation estimate accumulated over 1 hour (MRMS MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass2).

qpe_15min.description: Radar-only quantitative precipitation estimate accumulated over 15 minutes (MRMS RadarOnly_QPE_15M).

attrs.description: Optional dataset-level metadata attributes (e.g., source, processing history, CRS information).
